title: Line sketch: Highway Beneath the Fiery Sun
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: The composition captures a sprawling urban cityscape at sunset, with curving illuminated highways stretching across the foreground and midground. A massive swirling sun dominates the vibrant sky, casting dramatic and light over silhouetted buildings below. Bold, expressive and intense color contrasts emphasize movement and energy in the scene (derived from painting #100).
